chapter: Sanger, Ben Black and carnival balls
title: Letter to Nick LaRocca and teaching him to read music
summary: He reads his letter to LaRocca and recalls teaching him to scale on the pool-room blackboard.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: And they round dance and they do this, that and the other. I'm not going to interfere in their life. You know what I mean? Look at that stationery, the groom hall. This is a photostatic copy, you know? Now tell me when it starts to talk.

Well, this is a letter from Nick LaRocca, original cornetist with the original Dixieland man. I'm writing to him, I'm at the groom hall. I said, Dear LaRocca, I'm pleased to receive from you a copy of your Blue and the Blues. It is very popular here and I have requests for it every night. No doubt you know I have a jazz band at the groom hall hotel. Barry is again playing with us. We play most of your numbers each night. Tiger Ray, I got Tiger Ray in parentheses. Keep up the good work. Wishing you success and all the other boys who might know me, I am your friend. Your friend John D. Drey. Postscript. Do you remember the blackboard in the excelsior pool room? Where you learned to read music? I taught him to scale on the blackboard in the pool room. I used to take violin lessons from William Spector and Felicity and I had to pass that pool room to go home. And I'd walk home to say the nickel. And he was in there. And I knew he was a rocker. I knew he was trying to play trumpet. I taught him to scale. And he always liked me and he always boosted me. I've been trying to reminisce on an incident and it won't come back to me now that I think it's just the thing that you might be looking for. But I didn't know what you... They come and go. My memory... The filing cabinet is beginning to get weak. That grows up by age I guess, huh? Well...
Well no, but lack of practice. No more to talk to.
You see if I talk to you overnight, you say some word maybe it would bring back some incident.
